tagline: Deep bouclé walls to disappear into, with a crumb memory foam cushion that lifts out.
lead: A nervous dog, new rescue or puppy gets deep, soft walls to curl behind, out of sight of the room.
value: Most nest beds are one sewn unit. Here the cushion lifts out, the covers come off, and a waterproof layer catches what gets through.
intro: Birch is a bouclé nest dog bed with deep soft walls, a removable crumb memory foam cushion, a waterproof layer beneath the cover and machine-washable covers throughout. Small, Medium and Large.
points: High enough to curl behind, out of sight of the room.
It lifts out, so the base and the walls wash separately.
Under the cover. For puppies and older dogs, this is the part that saves the bed.
Soft to lie on, and at home in a room you sit in.
best_for: Nervous dogs, new rescues, puppies and older dogs who want somewhere soft, with sides to curl behind.
fit_note: The deep walls take up a large part of the outside footprint, so measure your dog curled up and size up if you are between sizes. Not sure? Ask us with their breed and weight.
care: Lift out the cushion, remove the covers and wash them following the sewn-in care labels. Air-dry fully before refitting.
seo_title: Bouclé Nest Dog Bed with Memory Foam Cushion | Snoozly
seo_description: Deep-walled bouclé nest dog bed for dogs who like to hide away. Lift-out crumb memory foam cushion, waterproof layer, washable covers. Small to Large.
alt: Birch bouclé memory foam nest dog bed
